column1: # SDD-019 nightly index contract. Every implementation of the index
# An empty input field means the input is absent for that night.
# An empty expected_index means the night does not score at all.
# Regenerate this file whenever a weight or cutoff in SleepIndex.h changes.
# Every consumer's tests then fail until it follows
# Renormalisation: an absent input drops out
# A negative leak is a sentinel and is dropped
# Dropping gives 40/80; clamping to full would give 60/100.
# Both sides of every band boundary
